description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It filters log messages to only pass the message content downstream, ignoring other metadata like priority, tag, or Throwable. The class is used to simplify log output by removing extraneous information.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that implements LogNode to pass only the message part of logs to the next node, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Default constructor without a next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Overrides LogNode.println to pass only the message string (msg) to the next node, with priority set to Log.NONE.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
